Title : 1980 BOSTON
Support: 2 LP
Matrix: 5646
Producer: Zebra Records
Vinyl: Black

Notes:
B&W&red insert cover
The cover states 30-Aug-1978. It is impossible. That show setlist has still to be recovered and it is very unlikely that this record can contain songs from that night.
I have never seen the record, but assuming that the songs are all from the same night, the only feasible show is 19-Sep-1978, which also present the same song sequencing.
